text:
## Common Exceptions & Resolutions  
### Failed Transfer — Insufficient Funds  
```
Exception: Customer attempted £5,000 transfer, balance only £3,000
Investigation: Confirmed balance at transaction time
Resolution: Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available
SLA: 1 business day (immediate notification)
```
name: Chunk 19/25

raw_entities.name: Failed Transfer Exception Handling
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for handling customer transfer attempts that fail due to insufficient account funds. Includes investigation of the failed transaction, customer notification, and guidance on retry options. SLA is 1 business day with immediate notification required.
context: Exception: Customer attempted £5,000 transfer, balance only £3,000
Investigation: Confirmed balance at transaction time
Resolution: Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available
SLA: 1 business day (immediate notification)

raw_entities.name: Transaction Exception Detection
raw_entities.description: Detection and recording of a customer transfer attempt that exceeds available account balance. The system identifies that the requested transfer amount (£5,000) exceeds the current balance (£3,000).
context: Exception: Customer attempted £5,000 transfer, balance only £3,000

raw_entities.name: Balance Verification Investigation
raw_entities.description: Formal investigation step to confirm the account balance at the time of the failed transfer attempt. Verifies that insufficient funds was the genuine cause of the transaction failure.
context: Investigation: Confirmed balance at transaction time

raw_entities.name: Customer Notification and Resolution Guidance
raw_entities.description: Communication step to notify the customer of the failed transfer, explain the insufficient funds reason, and offer guidance on retry options once funds become available.
context: Resolution: Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available

raw_entities.name: Operations Staff - Exception Resolution
raw_entities.description: Operations team member responsible for investigating the failed transfer, confirming the balance, and communicating the resolution to the customer.
context: Investigation: Confirmed balance at transaction time
Resolution: Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The individual customer who initiated the failed transfer attempt and is subject to the exception handling and notification process.
context: Customer attempted £5,000 transfer, balance only £3,000
Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available

raw_entities.description: A customer-initiated transfer transaction for £5,000 that failed due to insufficient available balance (£3,000). The transaction was rejected at the point of processing.
